name: Caelivex
description: Caelivex is Lazarus's most exclusive product, produced by an officially nonexistent subsidiary and available only through Spire-level medical concierge networks. It is a full-spectrum hedonic compound that simultaneously activates every known pleasure-response pathway — dopaminergic, opioidergic, serotonergic, endocannabinoid — in a precisely calibrated cascade that produces what users describe as 'the feeling that everything is exactly as it should be, forever.' It is chemically engineered to be non-depleting, meaning it leaves no neurochemical hangover.
effects: total, absolute hedonic saturation — described as 'perfect contentment'
profound sense of rightness with existence
elimination of all anxiety, grief, or want
no cognitive impairment — users remain functional
side_effects: the primary danger is behavioral, not neurological: users who experience Caelivex find all other experiences comparatively insufficient
progressive withdrawal from relationships and ambitions
extreme cost creates financial ruin even for Tier 4 users who access it
psychological dependency so profound it redefines the user's relationship with existence
rare: complete motivational collapse — users achieve bliss and simply stop engaging with the world
Lazarus is aware of all effects and considers them acceptable at the target market level
cultural_context: Caelivex is GLMZ's most dangerous secret — not because of what it does to the body but because of what it does to desire. The Spire uses it as a retirement drug, a reward, a political tool. Tier 4 users who discover it through Spire connections have been known to liquidate everything to maintain access. There are no Caelivex addicts on the Shelf because they could never afford it, but there are stories — the kind told to explain why certain Tier 4 officials stopped showing up, why a brilliant corporate lawyer suddenly cashed out everything and disappeared.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 city council member who was investigating Lazarus's gray market operations has gone completely quiet — her staff say she seems happy, which is not like her at all
A sample of Caelivex has been stolen from a Spire medical concierge and is being auctioned on the gray market; four different factions want it — some to use, some to analyze, one to destroy

Lazarus's internal ethics board has a document concluding that Caelivex is functionally a weapon of social control used by Tier 5 to pacify ambitious Tier 4 individuals — and the document's author has gone missing
